array.item: Check that the panel module is responding
Check connections and view ROM information
Review panel activity and display settings
Battery temperature is not available yet.
Your phone is cool. No optimization is needed.
Your visual profile has just been checked.
Your phone is running well. Check the visual profile to keep it responsive.
The visual profile is ready. Give your phone time to cool.
A lighter visual profile can help while your phone cools down.
Check the visual profile and release cached apps only if Android reports low memory. Recently used apps may need to reload.
Use normal visual detail. Existing panel fixes stay on.
Start with Light and reduce visual detail further as the battery warms up.
Build each background once, with lighter blur and media-wave detail.
Use the lightest blur path and fewer wave points. Background details are softer.
Saved. Restart to apply every integration.
Show the original panel transitions. Media waves keep moving in either setting.
Show background blur in Quick settings and notifications.
Use the GPU for prepared panel backgrounds in Light and Extra light.
Limit power use through Android\'s power service.
Limit battery use for apps you use less often.
Restore saved CPU frequency floors for balanced everyday use.
Raise CPU floors to at least 35% of the saved ceiling for quicker response.
The solid line is the reported clock. The dashed line is the allowed maximum. A lower clock is normal when the CPU is idle.
Updates once a second while this page is open. Monitoring stops when you leave or put the app in the background.
Active services are managed by Android
Saved. Restart the device to apply the framework policy.
Cached apps are not the same as running services. Lower limits can increase app reloads.
Prepare the panel background before it is needed.
Reuse compatible Quick settings layout work.
Keep compatible Quick settings content ready.
Prefer 120 Hz when the device can use it. Power saving and thermal limits still apply.
Use the supported launcher transition profile.
Use quieter notification colors. Restart SystemUI after turning this off.
Restart only the verified SystemUI process
The status bar disappears briefly. The lock screen may return.
Move recognized shader files into a backup
Restore CPU limits and the first saved system settings
Module switches are kept. A reboot may be needed for framework settings.
Reduce repetitive messages. Warnings and errors stay available.
Record frames and logs for 15 seconds
Refresh this report to check the framework scope.
SystemUI did not confirm this setting.
Enable Sunshine Parts, grant root and restart the device.
Scope not connected. Check LSPosed and restart.
These modes reduce visual work. They do not change CPU or GPU clocks, thermal protection or refresh rate.
Automatic uses Light from startup. It switches to Extra light when battery temperature reaches 39 °C. The battery signal clears at 37 °C. Battery temperature is not a CPU temperature reading.
Both effects are on by default. Layout and duplicate-work optimizations remain active in either mode.
Wave timing and playback speed remain native. This setting adjusts only the amount of geometry drawn.
Raise CPU floors to at least 50% of the saved ceiling. Uses more power and can increase heat.
Changes are checked against actual CPU policy files. This compatibility engine does not require the donor ROM\'s Samsung feature flag.
Recently used apps may need to reload. This does not force-stop every installed app.
Native refresh settings are verified when this option is applied.
Use only for suspected corrupt caches. Shader recompilation can temporarily increase stutter.
This lasts until reboot. Restart affected apps. The original value is saved.
Activity counters confirm that a path ran. They are not a measurement of frame rate or speed.
This is the app display rate, not a count of rendered frames. Native protection limits still apply.
This report covers the current SystemUI session. Counters reset when SystemUI restarts. They do not measure FPS or prove a performance gain.
Memory information is not available yet.
Android is managing memory. Give it a moment.
Memory is low. Eligible cached apps can be released.
Use Light UI workload while the device cools.
Some cached apps can be cleared if you need more memory.
Your system has enough memory for everyday use.
There is enough memory headroom. No optimization needed.
CPU clock history. Waiting for readings.
CPU monitor stopped. Check root access.
Couldn\'t read CPU clocks. Check root access.
The compatibility profile applies CPU policy limits when Samsung\'s processing feature is absent. Low power limits CPU ceilings to 80% of the saved baseline. Thermal protections remain active.
Each point pairs CPU load with the reported frequency. The highlighted point is the latest reading.
Updates every 200 ms while this page remains open, including in the background. Leave this page to stop monitoring.
The module is ready to use.
Some checks could not be completed.
Module connected and active\nin the system interface.
Keep native system behavior. Restart the phone after changing this option.
Native interface active. Module effects are paused.
Native interface kept\nwith module effects paused.
Restart to apply the runtime mode.
Keep full visual detail and the prepared panel background.
Use Light from 35 °C and Extra light from 42 °C.
Keep native motion and ROM blur, with fewer repeated QS updates.
Reduce panel motion and media detail, with native ROM blur.
Automatic uses no visual reduction below 35 °C.
Options controlled by the active visual profile are temporarily unavailable.
Choose a native launcher preset or follow the visual profile.
LowEnd normally; LowestEnd in Extra light.
This launcher routes Mass to the native HighEnd parameters.
Use the original parameters supplied by One UI Home.
The manual override is off by default. Launcher workload reductions do not depend on this selection.
Release unused module buffers under sustained memory pressure. Android manages app eviction.
Visual settings checked\nfor the selected workload.
Experimental integration unavailable in this build.
This build requires Retriever, One UI 8.0 and Android 16.
The root shell did not grant access.
Root access is available. The SystemUI connection needs attention.
The process is running module %1$s; this app is %2$s. Restart the device to load the installed module.
Native touch areas with less logging
Latest state retained with less logging
Native motion with fewer repeated updates
Updated when the battery temperature changes
Module buffers released under memory pressure
Native movement with fewer diagnostic allocations
Module connected and active in the system interface
Native interface preserved with module effects paused
Visual settings checked for the selected workload
Profile %1$s applied with lighter visual detail
Memory checked with automatic cleanup paused
Memory available without closing background apps
Repetitive diagnostic messages reduced for this session
Native frame rate votes with less logging
Native surface commits with less logging
Unchanged gesture areas reused by Android
Adjust visual effects during app transitions.
Read the SoundAlive state in the background.
Use a small prepared wallpaper blur and fewer media details. Keep animations at 0.8x.
Avoid edge extension during app transitions.
Access verified. Restart the device to load the module.
